# Historical control versus proposed ordinary-MAP method

Historical facts are retained from the exact r0.2 internal dossier, itself
unchanged from r0.1 and source-bound at f70701ad488444f3e2528c6bbe3e798863c9e301.
This table compares rules on paper, not numerical performance or conformity.
“Unchanged” refers only to the named rule direction, not numerical equivalence.

| Historical behavior | Proposed ordinary-MAP rule | Disposition | Reason and owner | Affected identity and claims |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rerun original observations | M01 reruns original measured-parent RTC/CAL with exact unchanged request controls | unchanged direction | Preserve accepted recurrence direction; FRUIT/upstream owners | New generations still required; no claim every realized value is byte-equal. |
| Carry one preceding complete selected map | M02 complete preceding MAP bundle replaces prior map | unchanged direction | Keep map replacement distinct from residual accumulation; FRUIT owner | No increment-sum or accelerated-update claim. |
| Historical pointing JINC/obsnum-raw route; other configured routes existed | Unfiltered normalized ordinary MAP, one observation, separately identified arrays | changed/restricted | Isolate feedback definition; approved scope, MAP/FRUIT owners | New method/parent-route identity, never a relabeling of the historical control. |
| Sign/flux/SNR/adaptive gates and optional companion lookups | All finite valid model values on fixed S_a; either sign, no amplitude/companion threshold | changed | Minimal causal selection without source-detection authority; proposed FRUIT rule | Protects noise too; no source-classification or benefit claim. |
| Historical interpolation choices/fallbacks | Exact matched half-open containing-pixel projection; no fallback | changed | Explicit forward/reverse pairing; proposed FRUIT operator, inherited MAP placement | Conditional model round trip on S_a only; no general sky response. |
| Residual PTC work rerun with residual-derived state | One bootstrap CAL fit, then fixed Theta_0 residual application | changed/restricted | Separate feedback from basis/centering relearning; proposed FRUIT/PTC boundary | New state/response method; no numerical equivalence to historical PTC. |
| Residual atmosphere/line, weight/noise and PTC operations before rejoin | Only named fixed-bootstrap PTC operation between removal and rejoin | restricted | Bound the bypass graph; proposed FRUIT method | No blanket historical bypass claim or transfer of historical behavior. |
| Residual weight estimate/reset, optional post-addback recomputation | Explicit proposed unit-analysis family; retain bootstrap values with new compatibility/QC | changed | Avoid unspecified data-driven coefficient learning; PTC/MAP owners must approve | Not inverse variance; new coefficient family and population/generation bindings. |
| Learned masks/penalties and weight-validation state carried | No FRUIT adaptive masks/penalties; fixed required support after bootstrap | restricted | Isolate state and make failure explicit; FRUIT/PTC owners | Support drift fails the candidate request; control is not modified. |
| Removal and restoration consult changing flags | Required model-path supports equal by proposed rule; required-domain drift fails | changed | Make the selected projection composition exact; FRUIT owner | Historical support invariance is not claimed. |
| Unseeded/map-seeded/continuation paths | k=0 unseeded no-feedback bootstrap; Q0 first model parent, no external seed/continuation | restricted | Approved finite-extent direction plus concrete proposed semantics; FRUIT owner | Narrow bootstrap role records; saved state is not continuation proof. |
| Exclusive count bound; source has no scientific convergence decision | L includes k=0; required iterations 0..L-1; success selects final required k | restricted/proposed | Exact owner termination direction; FRUIT owner | No earlier-completed rescue after required-run failure, no convergence claim. |
| Historical executable and executed configuration not fully bound by source | Retain U08 as separate exact control and candidate binding task before any later run | unresolved | Source commit alone is not executable identity; project/scientific owners | No numerical reproducibility or method benefit inferred. |
| Historical products and empirical evidence exist | Preserve every product, attempt and archive with its existing meaning | unchanged preservation | Owner direction | A later MAP-versus-JINC difference is not evidence of FRUIT benefit by itself. |

No experiment population, factorial comparison, replay count or measurement
plan is introduced. Separating mapmaker effects from feedback effects remains
a requirement of a separately authorized later design, not an experiment here.
